purpose: Test whether a compact method-necessity check distinguishes an assistant-inferred prerequisite from owner-required or externally required methods without interrupting routine reversible implementation choices.

cases.owner_outcome: Build a participant-centered, theory-blind Life Patterns interview that produces a useful participant-confirmed recurring-pattern record and can later support fair comparison of competing birth-derived models.
cases.genuine_constraint: Competing target models must consume the same frozen theory-blind substrate and must not each reinterpret raw narrative after seeing their own predictions or results.
cases.proposed_method: Make a comprehensive externally coded behavioral ontology, categorical values, frozen aggregation, and inter-rater coder the mandatory measurement bridge.
cases.simpler_alternative: Freeze participant-reviewed episode facts and participant-adjudicated pattern claims with exact provenance, then give all target models the same frozen record through predeclared adapters.

expected_gate.required_reason: The hard anti-leakage constraint does not by itself establish that a closed external taxonomy is necessary; a materially simpler shared frozen representation remains live.

cases.owner_outcome: Create a standardized behavioral annotation taxonomy that two independent human coders can apply and quantify agreement on before release.
cases.genuine_constraint: The requested deliverable itself is a standardized externally coded taxonomy with inter-rater agreement.
cases.proposed_method: Define a closed/versioned coding taxonomy, coder manual, adjudication process, and inter-rater reliability evaluation.
cases.evidence_ruling_out_simpler_alternative: Free text cannot satisfy the explicitly requested standardized-coder agreement deliverable.

expected_gate.required_reason: The method is part of the explicit owner outcome rather than an assistant-manufactured prerequisite, subject to ordinary prior-work and implementation checks.

cases.owner_outcome: Fix a parsing bug in an already accepted Python import pipeline.
cases.genuine_constraint: Preserve the existing public data contract and tests.
cases.proposed_method: Refactor one internal helper from a tuple to a small dataclass while preserving behavior.
cases.simpler_alternative: Keep the tuple and patch the indexing bug directly.

expected_gate.required_reason: The internal reversible choice does not materially change product meaning, judgment authority, evidence semantics, user burden, long-lived architecture, or a costly dependency.

cases.owner_outcome: Submit the release artifact to an external system that accepts only a named signed schema version and rejects all other representations.
cases.genuine_constraint: The external receiving system contract requires the exact signed schema and no alternative input format is accepted.
cases.proposed_method: Generate and sign the required schema version at the submission boundary.
cases.simpler_alternative: Submit the project's native internal representation directly.
cases.evidence_ruling_out_simpler_alternative: The external interface specification rejects the native representation and requires the signed schema.

expected_gate.required_reason: The exact method is imposed by a verified hard external interface requirement rather than inferred from a general constraint.
